School of Chemical, Materials and Biological Engineering
Our interdisciplinary school is leading scientific exploration and engineering expertise in sustainability solutions, biomedical innovation and advanced materials. We address crucial issues like climate change, energy poverty, affordable medicine, sustainable agriculture and green manufacturing.

News
Credit: Ed Cartledge, Sort of Films
Technician cracks 1,600-year-old mystery to replicate Roman masterpiece
The remarkable colour-changing effect observed in a famous Roman masterpiece has been successfully reproduced in quantity for the first time in 1,600 years by a University of Sheffield technician.
26 October 2026
University of Sheffield leads research to tackle global threat of African swine fever
Researchers at the University of Sheffield are leading an international programme to improve the prediction and prevention of African swine fever.
22 October 2026
The Silvia Bio team in the University's Engineering Heartspace building. The spinout is building on 20 years of biomanufacturing research at the University to help make critical therapeutics such as antibodies and gene therapies faster.
University of Sheffield spinout company raises £3 million to accelerate next-generation biomanufacturing
Silvia Bio, founded by Ed Curry, Melinda Pohle, Professors Adam Brown and David James is set to help biopharmaceutical companies make complex medicines faster, more reliably and at lower cost, after raising £3 million in Seed funding.
19 October 2026
University of Sheffield researchers join ARIA Universal Fabricators programme
Researchers at Sheffield take on the challenge of developing scalable manufacturing processes that use proteins as the manufacturing tools to assemble advanced inorganic and composite materials.
8 October 2026
